title: Wallet Tracker profile data (localStorage and synced Gist file)
description: Either this object as plain JSON, or an encrypted envelope (see $defs.encrypted).

u.description: last-modified time in ms; higher wins on merge

wallets.description: cash wallets and credit cards (kind: 'credit', limit, closeDay, dueDay, addedOn)

txns.description: type: income | expense | transfer | adjust | loan; amount, walletId, toWalletId, category, date (YYYY-MM-DD), note, recurringId, installmentId, planId, loanId

recurring.description: monthly rules: type, amount, walletId, category, day, start (YYYY-MM)

installments.description: walletId, total, months, rate, purchaseDate, closedAt

loans.description: dir: lent | borrowed; principal, total, date, due, freq, count, firstDue

prefs.description: the profile's look; one record, newest u wins

data.description: base64 AES-GCM ciphertext of the profileData JSON
